Website terms

Last updated: 9 October 2026

Information about using this website and enquiring about our accounting services.

Who operates this site

This website is operated by AMK Financial Services Ltd, trading as AMK. Trade Accountants. Registered in England and Wales, company number 13592888. VAT number 397139357. Registered office: 20 Nursery End, Stanford In The Vale, Faringdon, England, SN7 8PH. Contact: contact@amkaccountancy.co.uk.

Website information and advice

The website gives general information about our services. It is not personalised accounting, tax, legal or financial advice. Please obtain advice based on your circumstances before making decisions. Illustrative examples are labelled and do not represent client results or guarantee a particular outcome.

Packages, prices and working together

Package prices are starting monthly fees excluding VAT. Turnover ranges are guides, not minimum entry requirements. The services, allowances and qualifications shown with each package should be read together. We confirm your fee, responsibilities and agreed work in a written scope and engagement terms before work starts.

Booking a call or browsing the website does not create an accountant–client relationship. Any services are subject to acceptance, relevant checks and agreement of engagement terms. Those terms govern the work, payment, cancellation and any applicable liability provisions.

The Finance MOT is an initial review, subject to the scope and records requirements explained on the website. It is not an audit, assurance opinion or guarantee that every issue will be identified. Corrective or catch-up work is scoped and quoted separately.

Accuracy and availability

We aim to keep this website accurate and available, but information may change and access may occasionally be interrupted. If a service description or price is unclear, please ask us to confirm it before relying on it.

Content and acceptable use

Website content is owned by AMK or used with permission. You may view it and keep a copy for your own reference. Please obtain permission before republishing our content or using our branding. Do not misuse the website, introduce malicious code, attempt unauthorised access or interfere with its operation.

Links and responsibility

Links to other websites, including Google Calendar, are provided for convenience. Those services have their own terms and privacy arrangements. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability where doing so would be unlawful, including for fraud or death or personal injury caused by negligence, or restricts rights you cannot legally give up.

Questions and disputes

Please use our complaints page to raise a concern. These website terms are governed by the law of England and Wales, subject to any mandatory protections and court rights that apply to you. We may update the terms; the date above identifies this version.
